InsightBot AI: Technical Overview & Architectural Specifications

Product Name: InsightBot AI
System Purpose: InsightBot AI is a Private AI Research & Knowledge Agent for Teams.
Primary Database: PostgreSQL 17 serves as the primary persistence layer for documents and chunk metadata.
Vector Indexing: Semantic search utilizes vector cosine similarity, accelerated via the PostgreSQL pgvector extension with HNSW indexing when available.
Subsystem Separation: Browser research and private knowledge retrieval are separate subsystems. BrowserResearchAgent interacts autonomously with the web, while KnowledgeAgent queries private enterprise documents.
